fact: The Secretary of State for Justice says the Plataforma Única do Cidadão, integrating the civil registration and identity card components so they work as one, is at a very advanced stage of institutionalisation, and that identification systems are synchronised with the tax administration so the BI number doubles as the tax number.
title: Ministério da Justiça reitera aposta nas TIC para modernizar e simplificar serviços
